title: Summit Award Ticket Fee Schedule
content:
Fees on award tickets issued from a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program membership vary by the member's tier. The close-in window and the cancellation cutoff are the same at every tier.

| Tier | Close-in window (calendar days before first departure) | Close-in award fee per ticket (USD) | Reservations call center booking fee per ticket (USD) | Cancel-and-redeposit fee per ticket (USD) | Cancellation cutoff (elapsed hours before first scheduled departure) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | 21 | 75 | 25 | 125 | 1 |
| Summit Silver | 21 | 75 | 25 | 100 | 1 |
| Summit Gold | 21 | 50 | 25 | 75 | 1 |
| Summit Platinum | 21 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Summit Diamond | 21 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Summit Chairman | 21 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |

**Footnotes**

- The close-in fee applies to an award ticket booked fewer than 21 calendar days before its first departure.
- The call center fee applies to an award ticket booked through the reservations call center.
- The cancel-and-redeposit fee is charged per award ticket cancelled with its miles returned.
- A fee of 0 means that tier pays nothing for that item.

**Hypothetical comparison.** A Summit Silver member who books an award by telephone 10 calendar days before departure meets both the close-in fee of 75 USD and the call center fee of 25 USD; a Summit Platinum member in the same position meets fees of 0 on both.
